rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: **Thermal radiation.** Hot bodies emit energy as electromagnetic waves mainly in the infrared region; unlike conduction and conduction it needs no material medium.  ·  **Black body.** An ideal black body absorbs all incident radiation and, at the same temperature, emits the maximum possible radiation; a small hole in a hollow enclosure behaves like one.  ·  **Stefan's law.** The energy radiated per unit area per second is E = σT⁴; for a body at T losing heat to surroundings at T₀, P = σeA(T⁴ − T₀⁴), with σ = 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴.
